notes.title: ROCKET RUMBLE FULL RELEASE!
notes.notes:
It's finally happening! Rocket Rumble is set to blast off on May 23rd on Steam, Xbox and Playstation! 

[previewyoutube=dsDfHscl7t0;full][/previewyoutube]


Grab your Early Access copy today or hit that Wishlist button to be notified when we fully launch!



See you at the start line and GET READY TO RUMBLE!

-Rocket Rumble Team

notes.title: Fall Update
notes.notes:
[h3]Rocket Rumble just got an update! [/h3]

We've been working hard on making changes and improvements before our full release (TBD).  We've still got lots to do but you can check out the recent changes to Rocket Rumble here:


[h3]Rocket Rumble Version 0.2.78 Updates[/h3]

[list]
[*] New sound effects
[*] All characters now have voices!
[*] Added additional button prompts and improved existing ones 
[*] Improvements to In race Character Icons in the HUD
[*] Loading screen is fixed when exiting the game
[*] Fixed bug with tutorial crashing the game
[*] Customization Scroll bar now works as intended
[*] Disconnecting from our online servers no longer softlocks the game on the Splash screen
[*] When the Player indicator is active in options, all local players will have nametags above them during gameplay at all times. Hopefully this should help players keep track of where they are
[*] You can no longer get points for damaging yourself with your own items
[*] Killing a player with an item now rewards 4 points instead of 2
[*] Projectiles are now effected with the Boost pads in Holo Night
[*] Fixed bugs with the demo version of the game.
[*] Fixed bug where you could load multiple tracks at once from the Character Select
[*] Added custom Keybind Menu back into the options.
[*] Minor and Major internal bug fixes
[*] ...and, wait who are those shadowy figures on the Character Select?!

[/list]
[h3]Sad Updates:[/h3]

Removed Ghost Dog Pin from last years Halloween event due to a conflict. Players who had this item will receive an in game currency reward automatically

notes.title: Birthday Update!
notes.notes:
Rocket Rumble is having our first birthday today! It's been a whole year since we first released into Early Access on Steam and we're excited to celebrate this milestone! From now until the end of the month, use code BIRTHDAY in the Rocket Rumble shop to redeem your free birthday badge! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39114174/cd299fa4174ac258fb6e530667fcce147e94b006.png[/img]

This update also comes with a whole list of changes and improvements!
[list]
[*] New Logo
[*] New Race HUD
[*] Player Indicators based on Shape (for better accessibility) 
[*] Menu Mouse Support Added for both keyboard and Gamepad Players
[*] New Sound Effects (Did that dog just talk?!)
[*] New Powerup "Sugar Rush"
[*] Rocket Roy can now move left and right
[*] Powerup Item Type distribution re-balanced in Races
[*] Bug fixes  
[/list]


Stay tuned for more news and updates on the way! Until then, we'll see you at the start line! 


-Rocket Rumble Team

notes.title: NEW Visual Effects! (...and some bug fixes)
notes.notes:
Hi all! We're excited to post this small, but very cool update! We've begun a revamp of some of the visual effects in the game! We still have much more in the works, but for now, have a taste of some of these new effects:

[list]
[*] New Booster trails for all characters
[*] more effects when racing/interacting with players and track. 
[*] New sound effects on the main menu! [i]Nice and crispy![/i]
[/list]

Oh yeah and we also fixed some bugs...

[list]
[*] Fixed UI bugs
[*] Fixed bug where level and some XP information was not properly displayed on the main menu.
[*] Removed "extra coin icon" from main menu and Profile leftover from Valentines Event.
[*] Fixed Bug where the game would softlock after completing or would not run the tutorial level.
[*] Fixed Bug where after a first local race, the track selection on the Track Vote Menu would not refresh for each local race thereafter.
[*] Optimized some online interaction in the menu transitions.
[*] Other minor bug fixes and optimizations.
[/list]

notes.title: Sweet September Update
notes.notes:
We've been working hard on some BIG updates to Rocket Rumble! 

[h3]Missions[/h3]
Embark on Mission Chains of premade missions to unlock specific rewards. The mission system tracks tons of fun stats for a large variety of mission types such as:
[list]
[*] Number of matches played
[*] Kills
[*] Item hits
[*] Wins
[*] Characters used
[*] Number of checkpoints passed
[*] Tracks
[/list]
New missions will be added to the game as development progresses! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39114174/3ed88c2879e0cd2dd96c801fb053a689899dfba6.png[/img]

[h3]Sweet September Event[/h3]
With the addition of missions, we thought it would be a fun chance to have our first in-game event! From September 16th - 30th, exclusive event missions will be available with super [b]sweet[/b] rewards! Make sure to gobble them up before they're gone! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39114174/6ebf1271884f43d5f9305ac8cc3c07e0b484fde8.png[/img]

[h3]Health UI[/h3]
In the heat of the race, it was easy to lose track of your character! We've added a health indicator under your racer to help keep track of your character and your heath! 

[h3]Checkpoint VFX[/h3]
Checkpoints now do a little animation and change color when the first player passes them! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39114174/199ad831a13d0505c9601e5f709f3113b309970c.gif[/img]

[h3]Profile Customizations[/h3]
You can now customize your Rocket Rumble profile with boarders and frames! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39114174/dc3d2d8155e95a73919d0185600229bc77d29b32.png[/img]

[h3]Changelog[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added mission tray
[*] Randomly generated daily missions
[*] Hand Made Missions
[*] Mission Sequences (Quest Chains)
[*] Mission Tracking Types added:
  * Games, Kills, Hits, Wins 
  * Characters used 
  * Track played
  * Checkpoints passed
[*] New cosmetic items
[*] Profile banners/frames
[*] Main Menu notifications
[*] Level cap increase to 300
[*] VFX to support gameplay
[*] Revamped Menus
[*] Health indicator under player
[/list]

-Rocket Rumble Team

[*] Visual updates and fixes to Pirate Bay Track. New intro cutscenes.
[*] Added Skip feature on Track Vote when all votes have been cast.
